## Scientific, data-rights and privacy invariants

- [ ] Only original synthetic fictional trials; no real participant/clinical data, scraped assets or unapproved third-party source
- [ ] Participant/group-disjoint train, CV and held-out test remain intact
- [ ] Response, latency, target and any post-response feature excluded as predictors
- [ ] Predeclared seeds/splits/models/metrics unchanged, or separate versioned protocol review included
- [ ] Unknown/ineligible results remain N/A, not invented or suppressed
- [ ] No user secrets, tokens, private identifying content or sensitive uploaded reports disclosed

## Reproducibility and quality proof (do not check without actual log)

- [ ] Meaningful tests for new behavior, including negative/fail-closed states
- [ ] Exact SHA hosted `pytest`, `ruff`, `mypy` logs linked (or clearly **NOT RUN**)
- [ ] PM-10/11/12/13 replay hashes and eligibility verified where affected (or **BLOCKED**)
- [ ] UI/mobile/keyboard/privacy screenshot/evidence if actually tested; otherwise **NOT TESTED**
- [ ] README/changelog and methods correctly distinguish source, fixtures and real results
- [ ] Package/asset/dataset licenses, user/privacy and dependency changes reviewed

## Actual evidence links and review

- CI run URL with exact commit (or **NONE**):
- Genuine output checksum / artifact reference (or **NONE**):
- Reviewer decision / unresolved scientific or privacy blockers:
- Performance/host quota permission (if relevant):

**A prepared PR template is not PR permission.** New PR, review requests,
merge, public repository, app hosting, spending, website changes or outreach
require separate explicit owner approval. Never claim self-review or a passing
test based only on source files or toy fixture constants.
